NFBeats is a student project by:

Curtis King, Garrett Marcum,
Frankie Ribas,
David Bradbury, and Grifin Butler 


This app utilizes NFC technology to store and retrieve data from NFC tags and redirect to Spotify as a modern form of physical music media.

Think of it as a digital record player on your phone!

To put music onto a tag, tap the Write tab

To play a song from a tag, tap the Read tab

To write a Spotify link onto an NFC tag, you first need to find your desired link. Within Spotify, find whatever you want to store inside the tag. Now, find the '...' menu associated with your desired song, album, artist, or playlist, and open it to find the 'Share' button. After tapping the 'Share' button, tap the 'Copy link' button. This should copy the Spotify link to your device's clipboard. Return to the NFBeats app, and tap the 'Retrieve Link' button in the 'Write' tab. When prompted, tap the NFC tag to your phone. The Spotify link should now be stored within your NFC tag.

To read the Spotify link from your NFC tag, go to the 'Read' tab and tap the NFC tag to your phone when prompted. If the stored link is valid, your Spotify app will play the music shared by the link.\n
